# Tognar Toolworks

> > Tognar Toolworks is a specialized retailer of ski and snowboard tuning, waxing, and repair tools, featuring products from Swix, Wintersteiger, Beast, Dominator Wax, and their signature P-Tex Base Repair Iron.

Founded in 1986 by Jack in Ashland, Oregon, Tognar serves both professional ski technicians and DIY enthusiasts with comprehensive equipment for base repair, edge tuning, waxing, and binding installation. The site includes detailed how-to guides ranging from basic maintenance to World Cup-level tuning techniques.

## Key Topics

- P-Tex base repair
- Ski and snowboard waxing
- Edge tuning and beveling
- Binding mounting systems
- Swix tuning tools
- Wintersteiger equipment
- Beast edge guides
- Dominator Wax
- Base flattening and structure
- Gouge repair techniques
- Binding Freedom inserts
- Sun Valley Ski Tools
- Race wax applications
- Boot fitting tools
- FK/SKS tuning systems

## Base Repair & P-Tex Tools

- [Tognar P-Tex Base Repair Iron - 120v (US/CA)](https://tognar.com/tognar-p-tex-base-repair-iron-120v-us-ca): Tognar's signature P-Tex base repair iron for permanent ski/board welds
- [P-Tex Repair String for Base Welds](https://tognar.com/p-tex-repair-string-10): Durable P-Tex repair string for superior base gouge repairs
- [REPLACEMENT TIP FOR TOGNAR P-TEX BASE REPAIR IRON](https://tognar.com/replacement-tip-for-tognar-p-tex-base-repair-iron): Standard replacement tip (3/16" flat) for Tognar P-Tex repair irons
- [OPTIONAL WIDE TIP FOR TOGNAR P-TEX BASE REPAIR IRONS](https://tognar.com/optional-wide-tip-for-tognar-p-tex-base-repair-iron): Wide 1/2" spatula tip accessory for Tognar base repair irons
- [Snowboard & Ski Base Flatteners & Structure Tools](https://tognar.com/base-flattening-structure): Base preparation tools: true bars, scrapers, and structuring equipment
